prior_finding_closure.note: An external exact-GO is required before execute and is revalidated before each trainer spawn; QA2-R004 is a separate new schema contradiction.
Builder and runner use the same colon-delimited canonical physical-cell encoder.
The exact ordered three-seed tuple is mandatory.
Terminal and ambiguous attempt states prohibit duplicate retry or resume.
Declared midpoint/half-range vectors and no-arm-statistics flags are exact and SHA-bound.
Production trainer/runtime identities are hard-frozen and architecture is tied to the reviewed trainer SHA.
Scientific input bytes are rehashed, but the GO-bound package SHA-index bytes are not compared to their originally authorized SHA before each arm.
Named common failures are receipted, but other post-intent exceptions can leave an unterminalized attempt.

findings.title: Native pytest can false-PASS without executing the reviewed test
findings.proof: With PYTEST_ADDOPTS=--collect-only and deliberately nonexistent manifest/index environment paths, pytest collected one test, executed zero test bodies, and returned 0. The preflight accepts return code 0 as PASS.
findings.impact: A hostile or inherited environment can bypass reviewed native assertions or load unreviewed pytest/plugin code while producing a passing preflight receipt.
findings.required_fix: Use an isolated, sanitized environment; disable addopts/config/plugin autoload; invoke the exact reviewed test under isolated Python; and assert executed-test count/outcome rather than return code alone.

findings.title: GO/package/runtime hash checks lack descriptor and inode continuity
findings.proof: Hashing, JSON parsing, and later native execution reopen mutable user-owned paths. Modes 0555/0444 and nlink=1 do not prevent the owning UID from chmod plus atomic replacement and restoration before the post-audit.
findings.impact: A concurrent same-UID writer can cause the preflight to consume a different GO or execute unreviewed test/runtime bytes while both surrounding path-hash audits observe authorized bytes.
findings.required_fix: Hold verified descriptors through consumption, verify dev/ino/stat continuity, execute via a verified immutable descriptor or protected copied snapshot, and bind post-consumption identities.

findings.title: Runner accepts self-consistent material without frozen production provenance
findings.proof: The accepted synthetic fixture declares only shared_contract, only a historical-summary source, and an arbitrary all-true fixture_exact_production_gate check; _audit_material accepts it. Exact builder/splitter/source identities and the outer materialization COMPLETE receipt are not required.
findings.impact: Arbitrary self-consistent 10K/20K rows can become the GO-bound training contract without proof that the frozen MARS materialization gate produced them from the preregistered sources.
findings.required_fix: Require exact implementation/source role keysets and SHAs, exact production check keyset, and the exact outer materialization COMPLETE receipt bound to package manifest/index/GO/output closure.

findings.title: Post-intent exception classes can leave no FAIL receipt
findings.proof: A temp-only hostile probe forced subprocess.Popen to raise subprocess.SubprocessError. INTENT/stdout/stderr existed, but FAIL_RECEIPT.json did not.
findings.impact: The attempt is fail-closed on a later run, but the promised durable terminal failure evidence and exact failure denominator are incomplete.
findings.required_fix: Terminalize every catchable BaseException after INTENT, preserve ambiguous child identity when applicable, and fsync the attempt and parent directory.

findings.title: GO-bound package SHA-index bytes are not reverified before each arm
findings.proof: A temp-only probe uppercased all index digests, changing the index-file SHA while preserving its normalized semantic contents; _verify_closure still passed.
findings.impact: A byte identity explicitly authorized by external GO may drift between arm launches without fail-before-spawn.
findings.required_fix: Rehash package_sha_index and every GO binding against the frozen GO-authorized SHA immediately before every arm spawn.

findings.title: Material QA contract requires zero P0/P1 findings but runner GO cannot carry them
findings.proof: The material INDEPENDENT_QA_REQUIRED record says an exact GO must report zero P0/P1 findings. The runner's exact GO top-level keyset omits findings and rejects it as an extra key.
findings.impact: The only GO schema accepted by the runner cannot machine-prove the prerequisite declared by the frozen material contract.
findings.required_fix: Define one exact GO schema that includes findings={p0:0,p1:0}, binds the QA-required receipt, and is enforced identically by material and runner gates.

findings.title: Evaluator omits shared scientific contract and numerical runtime from release bindings
findings.proof: The evaluator dynamically imports the shared encoder/bounds/seeds and uses NumPy, but neither the imported shared-contract SHA nor exact Python/NumPy runtime is release/GO-bound; it also does not compare the paired run contract's shared binding to the imported module.
findings.impact: Cell grouping, bootstrap denominators, inference, and released statistics can change while all declared evaluator release bindings remain unchanged.
findings.required_fix: Bind and verify the exact shared-contract source, Python executable/version, NumPy version/core/config, and imported module identity before prepare and immediately before release.

findings.title: One-time claim durability and released-byte continuity are incomplete
findings.proof: The irreversible claim fsyncs only its file, not the directory entry, and trainer/CSV/holdout/targets/weights are hashed and then reopened through paths without held-descriptor or final inode continuity.
findings.impact: A crash can lose the one-time claim and permit a second release; a same-UID replacement race can substitute unreviewed code, data, or weights after authorization.
findings.required_fix: Fsync claim directory and parent before any test read, retain an unambiguous recovery marker, and consume verified held descriptors or immutable snapshots with final dev/ino/SHA checks.

findings.title: Evaluator exact-GO semantics are not exact
findings.proof: The GO has no exact top-level keyset, nonce, zero-P0/P1 finding counts, or QA-required SHA binding; any nonempty all-true checks dictionary passes.
findings.impact: A syntactically self-asserted receipt can open the irreversible numerical release gate without the machine-checkable independent-QA evidence contract used elsewhere.
findings.required_fix: Require an exact external GO schema with nonce/freshness/reviewer/findings/check keyset/QA-required binding and exact authorities.

findings.title: Preflight attempt evidence is not directory-durable or catchably terminalized
Package role validation accepts extra roles
findings.mitigation_in_frozen_package: The live remote package was independently proven to have exactly 15 expected roles and no extras.

findings.title: Candidate paths are caller-selected and absence is only a snapshot
findings.mitigation_in_frozen_binding: The live binding recomputation used the exact required three paths in exact order and proved all absent.

findings.title: Singleton detection can miss renamed or module-launched equivalents
Evaluator path canonicalization masks symlink provenance and does not require nlink/mode
Final evaluation output tree is not frozen or directory-durable
